testcase.name: The first administrator can only be created on an empty system
Only an administrator can manage accounts (FR-01, BR-07)
The administrator sets up departments, courses, lecturers and students
Wrong roles and bad input are refused with clear errors
One HoD cannot head two departments (ASM-04)
Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes, never as plain text (NFR-08)
Login succeeds with the right password and fails with a wrong one
Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (FR-02)
A deactivated user cannot log in (FR-04)
Changing a password needs the current one and 8+ characters (FR-03)
A reset password must be changed at the next login (FR-05)
BV-01 days late at every 24-hour boundary (BR-01)
BV-02 penalty at 3 and 4 days late (BR-01 cut-off)
BV-03 submission status on the deadline second (C2)
BV-04 resubmission allowed on the deadline, refused one second later (BR-03)
BV-05 file size 0, 1, 10 MiB and 10 MiB + 1 byte (FR-11)
BV-06 raw mark -0.1, 0, M and M + 0.1 (FR-13)
BV-07 raw mark with two decimals is rounded to one (EP: valid class)
BV-08 maximum mark 0, 1, 1000 and 1001 (FR-08)
BV-09 new deadline equal to now is refused, one second later accepted (FR-08)
BV-10 title length 0, 1, 200 and 201 characters (FR-08)
BV-11 extension earlier, equal to and one second after the deadline (BR-02)
BV-12 password length 7, 8, 128 and 129 characters (FR-03)
BV-13 username length 2, 3, 32 and 33 characters
BV-14 four failed logins do not lock, the fifth does (FR-02)
BV-15 lock lasts exactly 15 minutes (FR-02)
BV-16 menu choice 0, 1, n and n + 1 (EP: numbers, words, empty)
BV-17 typed mark: -0.1, 0, M, M + 0.1 and two decimals (FR-13)
BV-18 typed text at the maximum length and one over
ISO 8601 text round-trips through DateTime
Console format without seconds is accepted
Leap days are handled (boundary values)
Invalid dates are rejected with ValidationError
One day apart is exactly 86400 seconds
Dates far in the future work (boundary values)
BR-01 decision table, M = 100, raw = 75
The final mark never goes below zero
Marks are held to one decimal place
The penalty is a share of the maximum mark, not of the raw mark
ConsoleIO asks again until the input is valid
ConsoleIO throws InputClosed when the input ends
LoginScreen shows a plain message for a wrong password, then exits
A student can submit through the menu and gets a receipt
An HoD sees only their own department's marked work (FR-15, BR-07)
Approve, preview and release, then the student sees the result (FR-17, FR-18)
Release with nothing moderated is refused
Release is all-or-nothing (FR-17)
Amend needs a reason, re-applies BR-01 and is audited (FR-16, FR-19)
A lecturer cannot change a mark once it is moderated (BR-07)
An HoD's audit view never shows another department (FR-20)
Backup once per day, and restore brings the old data back (FR-21)
A new database gets the schema and passes the integrity check
Users round-trip with their role and scope
Usernames are unique and case-insensitive
Failed logins and lockout are saved
A submission, its versions and its mark are saved and reloaded
The database refuses a mark that breaks final = raw - deduction
The audit log is append-only and filterable
A transaction that is not committed is rolled back
SQL injection text is stored as plain data (NFR-09)
On-time submission is stored with size and SHA-256 (FR-11)
Late submission is accepted and marked LATE (C2)
Files are validated: missing, empty and over 10 MB are refused
A student not enrolled in the course cannot submit (BR-07)
Resubmission keeps every version until the deadline (FR-12, BR-03)
Marking applies the BR-01 penalty and writes an audit row
Marks outside 0..M and empty feedback are refused (FR-13)
A correction needs a reason and is audited with old and new values
An extension needs a reason, moves the deadline later and fixes LATE (DC-01)
An extension can be granted before the student submits (DC-02)
Students never see marks before release (FR-14, BR-04)
A submission exactly at the deadline is SUBMITTED
A submission one second after the deadline is LATE, not rejected
Resubmission before the deadline adds a version and keeps the old one
Resubmission after the deadline is refused (BR-03)
Resubmission after marking is refused (BR-03)
Full life cycle: mark, approve, release
Amend moves MARKED to MODERATED and keeps RELEASED as RELEASED
Events not allowed in a state are refused
An extension turns LATE back into SUBMITTED (DC-01)
